params.text: When I was about twelve or thirteen, I spent my summers in Nazreth. It's called Adama now.
I stayed with my aunt. My sister was there, and my cousin too.
In the middle of the patio in front of her house, there was a small tree.
It wasn't tall. It didn't bear fruit. It was just always there.
After breakfast, we were often sent outside while the room was cleaned.
